skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Behind the Words
skins.content: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Behind the Words. Morgan's outfit for when she's drafting her next work. A classic windbreaker makes an odd pairing for form-fitting innerwear, a bold statement showing that a serious attitude and a rebellious personality don't have to clash.
skins.quote: 'Aside from memoirs, I do occasionally write fiction. Here, have a peek—Oh, don't mind the wine stains, but the characters' deeds feel mighty familiar, don't they? Doesn't matter what I write—my pen hand keeps going back to the old gang. It's a real headache, I tell you!'
